name: Umami meatball rice bowl
title: Meatball bowls

steps.text: Cook the itsu meatballs as the pack says.
Smash the cucumber, chunk it; mix with chilli oil and 1 tbsp rice vinegar.
Grate the carrot, mix with edamame, 1 tbsp rice vinegar and a drizzle of sesame oil.
Rice into bowls, top with cucumber, carrot and edamame, and the meatballs.
Finish with sesame seeds, spring onion, radish and soy sauce.

equipment: a frying pan or the oven for the meatballs
